pro_course_detail.title: Practical English course
pro_course_detail.description:
My "Practical English" course covers a few different types of classes.
As a British English teacher, these lessons focus on specific British English question forms, phrases and idioms.

🫱🏼‍🫲🏼 How Are You?
Learn different question forms for the basic: How are you?
And learn some different replies to this important question! 🎓
This lesson will really help you to become more confident and sound more like a native English speaker 😎
You will be sent a PDF worksheet after class to keep for your English learning file.

🗣️ Pronunciation Practice ✔️
Learn the differences between British English and American English words with me.
This look into the differences between the two types of English will help you to become more familiar with a wider range of vocabulary and will help you in your travels, business meetings, and social occasions.

🆎 Specific Phonic Sounds 🔉
These lessons cover the most common sounds that many struggle with: the /th/ sound, the /r/ sound, the /l/ sound, and the /v/ sound.

👋🏽 Clever Ways to Say Goodbye in English 🙋🏽‍♂️
Want to take your boring “goodbye” and turn it into something friendlier or more interesting?
In this lesson, we'll discuss some English phrases and expressions you can say instead of just plain old “goodbye.”

👍🏽 Yes or....? 🤔
The word “yes” can be interpreted in so many different ways, depending on your context,
tone, and word choice. 
In this class, we explore the many nuances of this word and its synonyms.

💪🏽 Conquering “Word Whiskers” and Achieving Fluency 💬
In this class, we will cover: 
What are “word whiskers”? 
Why do they need eliminating? 
What are the 3 keys to overcoming word whiskers?

⌚ Telling the Time 🕰️
It’s time to learn how to tell the time in English!
Everyone studies numbers when they first start learning a new language. However, talking about time involves more than the numbers on the clock. You can sound more like a native by using the same phrases and terms that most English speakers do.

I firmly believe that it is best to talk about subjects that already interest you, so that you can learn English that you will be able to use straight away. pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Writing Corrections (offline)
pro_course_detail.description:
Once you know how to answer IELTS Writing Tasks effectively, you will need lots of practice and feedback. I can give this to you in lesson, but, bearing in mind that each Writing Task 2 answer takes about 40 minutes to write, this is not an efficient way. This is why I offer a Writing Corrections service. 

These are high quality and professional writing corrections for IELTS writing task 1 (Academic and General Training) and task 2. With this service, I will : 

✍️ Show your mistakes, 

✍🏻 Correct your writing, 

✍🏽 Give suggestions for how your writing can be improved, 

✍🏾 Explain your vocabulary and grammar mistakes,

✍🏿 Give IELTS band scores and explanations for them,

✍️ Explain and show how you can get higher band scores.

See an example of one of my writing corrections here 🔗 https://docs.google.com/document/d/13aDz6GRrD--aELY8TnmbxGV5g2JLT5W0JItxLe2IMdc/edit?usp=sharing

--

📕 How to book this service 📘

1) Send me a message in italki to let me know you are interested in this service and send me your IELTS writing you want me to correct.
Here are some example IELTS writing questions if you do not have any to use 🔗 https://drive.google.com/open?id=15qNmRP3o-cQzSw6okOiEbQXvY62ZKL6w

2) Book a lesson in my calendar. You can choose any time that is available. Which time does not matter because this is not a real lesson. 

3) I will send you your correction, either through italki or email, within 48 hours of accepting your lesson request.

4) Once you have received my correction, you should confirm with italki that we had our lesson(s) in order to pay me.

5) I will also answer any questions you have about the correction, free of charge!

--
⭐ One 60 minute italki lesson = one IELTS Writing Task 1 OR one IELTS Writing Task 2.

⭐ Please only send me typed pieces of writing; I cannot work with handwritten texts.

Thank you!
